correctness.rationale: The Heron-formula reduction, primitive normalization, parity and gcd steps, the mod-8 obstruction, and the converse scaling family were rederived. A separate exact-integer scan over 4,498,500 parameter pairs found 44 predicted two-prime-support cases and zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: MacDougall's available full text, Bailey-Gosnell bibliographic material, Read's publisher extract and references, OEIS A387908, synonymous prime-support searches, and current SCOPE records were checked. No equivalent area-prime-support classification was located. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the uninspected full text of Read (2025) is the principal residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem completely classifies the minimum possible distinct-prime support of the area in the classical family of arithmetic-progression Heronian triangles, yielding a unique primitive core and an explicit full scaling family without a size cutoff.
